next_install_boundary.caller: One successor maintenance start. After the existing fresh native unit and Telegram-connected checks, call retain_owner with the installed successor pins and the remaining startup-observation deadline.
next_install_boundary.service_recheck: The successor adapter must forward that deadline to the existing service observation and recheck unit invocation, cgroup and kernel identity. The observer uses the same Unix connection for SO_PEERCRED and identify.
next_install_boundary.writer: Use the existing exclusive private evidence writer and retain the sized SHA-256 reference in the same maintenance start record. Copy that exact reference to installation.native_owner_observation for the D02 current check.
next_install_boundary.failure: Preserve the installed-service outcome. An absent proof holds D02 admission. No additional start command or user effect follows from an observation failure.
